chunks.title: Halkbank (Halkbank) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Halkbank is a Turkish State Bank headquartered in Türkiye. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Official COP31 Main Partner; launched dedicated COP31 TRY 100B SME Sustainability Transformation Package (31 products). Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: TRY 100 billion COP31 SME Sustainability Transformation Package (31 green/social credit products, partly KGF-backed; TRY 424B cumulative green/social contribution). Source verification: https://www.cnbce.com/haberler/halkbank-cop31-icin-hazirladi-kobilere-100-milyar-tl-finansman-h41356.

chunks.title: Halkbank Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Halkbank provides the following climate financing instruments: SME Sustainability Transformation Loan (31 products), KGF-Backed Green Loan, EV Charging & Solar Loan, Women & Youth Entrepreneur Green Credit. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 25,000 to USD 50,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: SME, Mid-Cap Enterprise, Women/Youth Entrepreneur, Large Corporate.

chunks.title: Halkbank Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Halkbank: SME Green Transition, Renewable Energy, Energy Efficiency, Circular Economy & Zero Waste, Clean Transport & EV, Water Conservation. Target geographic focus includes: Türkiye. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Halkbank Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Halkbank's application form: Turkish SME / tradesperson / corporate registration (VKN & KOSGEB/KOBİ status); Selection among 31 eligible green/social transformation credit categories; KGF guarantee or collateral documentation; Environmental permit & vendor invoice/proforma for green equipment. Explicit exclusion rules: Non-eligible speculative lending; High-pollution non-compliant operations. Official application portal: https://www.halkbank.com.tr/en/sustainability.html.

chunks.title: Halkbank Form Template: Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application
chunks.text: Halkbank uses the 'Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application' workflow governed by BRSA (BDDK) Sustainable Banking Guidelines, Turkish Green Taxonomy & EU CBAM Readiness. Typical review timeline is 1–4 weeks (Branch/Corporate RM Intake -> Green Eligibility Check -> Credit Approval). Form sections required: 1. Applicant Identification, 2. Product Selection, 3. Green Technical Criteria, 4. Credit & Collateral, 5. Compliance, 6. Summary.
